text: The Halewyn Philharmonic has appointed Greta Oyelaran as its new conductor, according to a statement released Thursday by the orchestra’s board and a dossier circulated to members. Ms. Oyelaran, 41, will take up the post in September, succeeding Armand Vale, who is retiring after 12 seasons. In the board minutes, chair Elise Montfort said the appointment followed a three-month search that drew 19 applicants from seven countries. The orchestra said Ms. Oyelaran, formerly associate conductor of the Northmere Symphony, will lead its 2027 season opening at the Kestrel Hall in Veydon. The board also approved a five-year contract and a reported annual salary of 214,000 crowns.
